work_item: BODY-1 B03 retained exact math report context follow-up
route_method: The normal_route integration tests invoke the actual CLI executable in fresh child processes and same-case stores. Engine unit tests reconstruct the typed report and simulate file recovery at the adopted pre-confirmation journal edge.

report_types.statistics: Statistics is reconstructed from retained input_values and input_units; exact struct equality and canonical pretty JSON must match.
report_types.normalized_probability_weights: NormalizedProbabilityWeights is reconstructed from retained input_weights.
report_types.finite_probability_statistics: FiniteProbabilityStatistics is reconstructed from retained outcomes and weights.
report_types.event_probability: EventProbabilityResult is reconstructed from retained outcomes, weights and event values.
report_types.polynomial_evaluation: PolynomialEvaluationReport is reconstructed from retained source expression and bindings.
report_types.linear_system: LinearSolution is reconstructed from original_coefficients and original_rhs; the independently checked exact linear certificate must match the full saved report.
report_types.linear_equation: LinearEquationSolution is reconstructed from equation_left and equation_right.
report_types.quadratic_equation: QuadraticSolution is reconstructed from equation_left and equation_right.

producer_consumer.producer: A normal Japanese math request commits an exact typed report with its complete JSON text as the prior result.
producer_consumer.consumer: A following same-case 詳しく説明して request identifies the exact report schema, recomputes from the retained operands, checks the full typed report and serialized text, and emits exact intermediate values with a dependency on the prior result ID.
producer_consumer.bounded_output: Lists and row operations display at most 16 entries. Polynomial and equation sides display at most 512 Unicode scalar values; linear-system coefficient and RHS scalars display at most 128 and proof matrices show at most four rows. The full exact report remains available in prior history.
producer_consumer.tampering: Changes to recognized report values or field sets return MATH_CONTEXT_INVALID rather than explain a mismatched result.

lineage_and_recovery.normal_route: Each math explanation keeps exactly the previous result ID dependency and its sealed context_result_ref.
lineage_and_recovery.statistics_file_recovery: The recovery test verifies the retained statistics report, confirms the prior physical file write, preserves bytes and modification time, and uses one unchanged action identity without resending.
lineage_and_recovery.probability_file_recovery: The recovery test verifies a retained normalized-weight report, confirms the prior physical file write, preserves bytes and modification time, and uses one unchanged action identity without resending.
lineage_and_recovery.quadratic_equation_file_recovery: The recovery test verifies a retained quadratic report, confirms the prior physical file write, preserves bytes and modification time, and uses one unchanged action identity without resending.
